Dashed line: nominal coverage. Counts show observations inside intervals / total observations.
Draws: 1. Intervals predict corrected survey observations; they do not validate mapped mean-prevalence CrIs.
Repeated draws reuse the same sites/cells. Fold dots are descriptive, not confidence intervals.

Blue line: posterior mean. Black dots: corrected observations inside the 95% interval; orange triangles: outside.
Bands are pointwise predictive intervals. Ordering is not geographical and does not demonstrate predictive discrimination.
Cell means give sampled sites equal weight; pp: percentage points. Draws: 1. Intervals predict corrected survey observations; they do not validate mapped mean-prevalence CrIs.
